title: Beef and Olive Tagine with Preserved Lemon
meta_description: A Moroccan beef and olive tagine built on French braising logic. Halal, no alcohol. Preserved lemon, saffron, slow heat. 60 minutes, real flavour.
og_title: Beef & Olive Tagine with Preserved Lemon
og_description: Moroccan tagine meets French braise discipline. Halal beef, green olives, preserved lemon, saffron. One pot, one hour. The kind of cooking that makes your kitchen smell like a place.

image_briefs.prompt: Top-down view of a rustic clay tagine lid half-removed, revealing a deep amber beef and olive tagine with visible saffron-stained broth, potato wedges, green olives, and strips of preserved lemon rind. Scattered fresh parsley. Warm natural side light. Linen surface. No garnish props.
image_briefs.alt: Beef and olive tagine with preserved lemon in a Moroccan clay pot, top-down view

image_briefs.prompt: Flat lay on a pale stone surface: a small bowl of raw beef chunks, a pile of potato wedges, a handful of green olives, half a preserved lemon cut to show the rind, a tiny bowl of saffron threads, a small dish of turmeric and ginger powder. Olive oil in a glass bowl. No labels, natural light.
image_briefs.alt: Raw ingredients for beef olive tagine laid out flat: beef, potatoes, olives, preserved lemon, saffron, spices

image_briefs.prompt: Close-up of a heavy enamelled Dutch oven on a gas hob. Onions and spices are being stirred with a wooden spoon; the mixture is golden-ochre from turmeric with visible garlic. Steam rises gently. Hand visible at edge of frame. Warm kitchen ambient light.
image_briefs.alt: Blooming spices and onions in olive oil in a Dutch oven, turmeric and ginger visible

image_briefs.prompt: A wide shallow ceramic bowl, white or cream, with a generous serving of beef tagine: two pieces of beef, potato wedges, olives, and visible sauce pooled in the bowl. A strip of preserved lemon rind draped over the top. A torn piece of flatbread resting on the rim. Side angle shot, soft natural window light from the left.
image_briefs.alt: Plated beef and olive tagine in a white bowl with preserved lemon and flatbread
